Attached is a first pass: scim_mapping.csv and a filled SIG answers workbook (sig_answers_v2.xlsx). Quick notes inline:

- SCIM mapping: we sync core attrs (userName, givenName, familyName, email, active) and group membership when customers enable group sync. Column headers include targetAttribute, sourceAttribute, transform. I flagged attributes we consider system-managed (redwood_id, created_at) as internal-only.

Alice — thanks for the clear list. Please find the evidence and answers attached and summarized below. We've gone through this with Product and Identity; let us know if you need anything else.

What we attached:
- scim_mapping.csv (CSV): attribute name, source, transform, notes (includes deprovision TTL and group sync behavior).
- mfa_attestation.pdf (PDF): short attestation, signed by Product Security, states MFA enforced for all interactive user accounts and lists supported authenticators (TOTP, FIDO2 hardware keys, passkeys).
- sig_answers_v2.xlsx (XLSX): updated SIG answers workbook with confirmations and references to our SOC 2 report where relevant.

Summary answers: 
- SCIM / Provisioning: Redwood supports SCIM 2.0. We sync userName, name (given/family), emails, active, and optional custom attributes. Group membership sync is supported and maps to tenant role assignments. Deprovisioning sets active=false and we hold disabled users for 30 days by default before permanent deletion; this is configurable for Dedicated/Private deployments.
- MFA: Enforced for interactive user logins across the hosted platform. Supported methods: TOTP, SMS (legacy), FIDO2/WebAuthn (hardware keys), and passkeys. Service principals and machine-to-machine tokens use scoped API keys or short-lived OAuth tokens and are excluded from interactive MFA requirement; compensating controls include fine-grained scopes, token rotation, and audit logging.
- RBAC / Least privilege: Attached role catalogue (see Drive link) and recommended starter roles: Tenant Admin (minimal set of admin privileges), Developer (model deploy and logs), Analyst (read-only model metrics, query), Support (session trace view, no config write). We recommend using tenant-scoped roles and limiting cross-tenant privileges; enforce just-in-time elevated access for sensitive actions and keep audit trails.

Next steps / action items:
1) Nimbus to confirm if they want group sync enabled — we can enable a trial and share a test tenant.
2) If you want a signed statement on hardware key enforcement in a specific region, Marissa can work with Security to produce that variant.
3) Karthik will drop the authoritative role export into the Drive folder for your records.

If anything missing, reply here and we'll loop in Security.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
